title.zh: 将菲律宾科学中学北拉瑙校区设于北拉瑙省Balo-I市镇，为此修订第8461号共和国法第4(A)条的法案
title.en: An Act Fixing the Site of the Philippine Science High School Lanao Del Norte Campus in the Municipality of Balo-I, Province of Lanao Del Norte, Hereby Amending for This Purpose Section 4 (A) of Republic Act No. 8461
title.orig: An Act Fixing the Site of the Philippine Science High School Lanao Del Norte Campus in the Municipality of Balo-I, Province of Lanao Del Norte, Hereby Amending for This Purpose Section 4 (A) of Republic Act No. 8461

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2000/ra_8809_2000.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section 4 (a) of Republic Act No.8461 is hereby amended to grant the Philippine Science High School Board of Trustees the necessary power and duty to fix the site of the Philippine Science High School Lanao del Norte Campus. Such an amendment shall read as follows:
"SEC. 4 (a). To fix the site of the PSHSLNC in the Municipality of Balo-i, Lanao del Norte;"
Rules and Regulations. — The Department of Science and Technology shall issue the necessary rules and regulations to effectively carry out the effective implementation of this Act.
Repealing Clause. — All laws, decrees, presidential issuances, rules and regulations, or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Act are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. — This Act shall take effect upon its approval and completion of publication in at least two (2) national newspapers of general circulation.
Approved, August 16, 2000.
